tcs.test_item:
The system shall create a new preset in an empty slot when the '+' button is short pressed in the Presets Pop-up.

(Short press on an empty slot in the Presets Pop-up)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot holds a stored station
3. At least one preset slot is unset
4. The currently tuned station is not stored as a preset
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press the "All Presets" button on the Playing Tab
4. Record the frequency of the currently tuned station shown on the Playing Tab
5. Press the preset slot displaying a plus sign "+" in the Presets Pop-up and read the content displayed in that slot
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The Presets Pop-up is displayed over the Media screen
4. The frequency of the currently tuned station is recorded
5. The preset slot in the Presets Pop-up displays the station recorded in step 4 and no longer displays a plus sign
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
